# === 扫码登录功能部署脚本 ===
ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$deployDir = 'C:\qaxqjt-server'
$authB64 = ''
$routeB64 = ''

Write-Host '=== 部署扫码登录功能 ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan

# 备份原文件
$authFile = "$deployDir\server\src\controllers\auth.js"
$routeFile = "$deployDir\server\src\routes\v1\index.js"

if (Test-Path $authFile) {
    Copy-Item $authFile "$authFile.bak" -Force
    Write-Host '已备份 auth.js' -ForegroundColor Green
}
if (Test-Path $routeFile) {
    Copy-Item $routeFile "$routeFile.bak" -Force
    Write-Host '已备份 index.js' -ForegroundColor Green
}

# 写入新文件
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($authFile, [System.Convert]::FromBase64String($authB64))
Write-Host '已更新 auth.js' -ForegroundColor Green

[System.IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($routeFile, [System.Convert]::FromBase64String($routeB64))
Write-Host '已更新 routes/v1/index.js' -ForegroundColor Green

# 重启 pm2
Write-Host '重启 API 服务...' -ForegroundColor Yellow
pm2 restart qaxqjt-api
Start-Sleep -Seconds 5

# 验证
Write-Host '验证扫码登录接口...' -ForegroundColor Yellow
try {
    $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:3001/v1/auth/qrcode/create' -Method Post -TimeoutSec 10
    Write-Host '扫码登录接口部署成功！' -ForegroundColor Green
    $r | ConvertTo-Json
} catch {
    Write-Host '接口验证失败:' $_.Exception.Message -ForegroundColor Red
    pm2 logs qaxqjt-api --lines 20 --nostream
}

Write-Host ''
Write-Host '=== 部署完成 ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan
